fgw.featset_baseline.citation: arXiv:2602.18025 appendix E; URMA arXiv:2409.06366 appendix A
fgw.featset_baseline.description: node attributes the baseline embodiment-grouping method reads. Its appendix E takes URMA's local joint/foot descriptors verbatim, and URMA's d_j contains damping and a friction coefficient -- which is what forces D6 onto the qfrc_applied variant (proposal 9.2.6)

fgw.hyperparameters_baseline.description: POT settings the baseline uses for the FGW distance

deviations: table 8 gives epsilon = 1e-3, i.e. the entropic solver; the exact conditional-gradient solver is used so that an isomorphic pair returns an exact zero, which 9.3.4's 1e-12 assertion requires
table 8 gives a Euclidean feature ground metric; the squared Euclidean is used so the fused objective stays homogeneous with the square_loss structure term and alpha means one thing at every scale

omitted_urma_fields.general_robot_part: kp, kd, sigma_a, m, L, W, H are constant within a robot
omitted_urma_fields.n_child_joints: structural; carried by the FGW shortest-path term over the same edges
omitted_urma_fields.stiffness: jnt_stiffness is identically zero on every robosuite arm joint
omitted_urma_fields.velocity_limit: no MuJoCo 3.3.2 field; robosuite keeps it in controller configs
